candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the Thai consonant 'ม' (Mo Ma) or the Latin letter 'm'.
This feature vector represents locative and prepositional markers primarily in Thai and English, indicating spatial or relational context.
This feature vector activates on conjunctions, prepositions, and grammatical connectors in Thai and English.
These tokens represent Thai character combinations and common word fragments often associated with text processing or subword tokenization models.
This vector activates for common Thai words and syllable fragments.
This vector represents Thai words and character n-grams containing the Thai consonant 'น' (No Nu).
This vector is activated by common Thai consonant characters used in the alphabet and text.
These tokens represent the Thai vowel sara ii (สระอี) combined with various consonant sounds or initial modifiers.
This vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ว' (wo waen) and its various combining forms and frequent syllable combinations.
This vector activates on sub-word tokens containing Thai script characters and miscellaneous proper nouns.
